content.name: Selin Yıldız
content.title: Senior Marketing Manager DACH
content.summary: Marketing manager with ten years in Hamburg consumer brands, from travel to bicycles to natural cosmetics. Currently owns the DACH marketing plan and a €1.3m budget for a certified natural cosmetics brand, where a drugstore launch took revenue in Austria and Switzerland past €4m. Works fluently in German, Turkish and English.

experience.title: Senior Marketing Manager DACH
bullets: Own the annual marketing plan and €1.3m budget for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, leading two marketing managers and a working student.
Planned the brand's entry into Austrian and Swiss drugstore chains with shelf activation and sampling, reaching €4.2m in combined revenue in 2025.
Commissioned a twice-yearly brand tracker from a Hamburg research agency, using the results to refocus messaging on skin sensitivity and halve wasted media.
Set up GDPR-compliant consent and CRM journeys with the data protection officer, growing the opt-in customer base to 180,000 contacts.

experience.title: Marketing Manager
bullets: Managed marketing for a mid-sized e-bike manufacturer selling through 260 specialist dealers in Germany and the Netherlands.
Built a dealer co-marketing fund of €400,000 a year, with clear rules and reporting, which raised dealer participation from 35% to 71%.
Coordinated the launch of a cargo e-bike range at Eurobike, generating 1,900 dealer pre-orders in the first season.
Moved the product catalogue from print to a configurable digital version, saving €85,000 in annual print and postage costs.

experience.title: Junior Marketing Manager
bullets: Produced seasonal campaigns for North Sea and Baltic holiday packages across print, newsletter and travel fairs.
Tested early-booking offers across 12 newsletter segments, raising January booking revenue by 19% compared with the previous year.
Organised the company stand at ITB Berlin for two years, coordinating suppliers, staff rotas and lead capture.

education.details: Final grade 1.7. Thesis on consumer trust in natural cosmetics certification labels.

achievements.title: Retail expansion
achievements.detail: Brand listed in two Austrian and one Swiss drugstore chain within 14 months.

achievements.title: Dealer programme
achievements.detail: Dealer co-marketing participation more than doubled after redesigning the fund rules.
